description: Generic editor for an ordered list of model items. Each item is edited via TmEmailObjectFields, and the list supports adding, removing, and reordering (move up/down) entries.

parameters.name: Items
parameters.description: The list of sub-elements being edited (mutated in place).

parameters.name: ItemPrimary
parameters.description: Property names shown first for each item.

parameters.name: OnChanged
parameters.description: Raised after the list or any item changes.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders the list read-only: the native controls are disabled and every mutating method returns early, so a host that emulates a click (bUnit, a synthetic event) still cannot change the document.
